title: Volcanoes of Europe
intro: 10 volcanoes of Europe, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mutnovsky
rounds.fact: Mutnovsky is a complex volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 2,288 m in the source data. The data places it in Russian Federation.
